Oracle Fusion 26D: what to expect

26D is the next Oracle Fusion Cloud quarterly update. Oracle has published its 26D What's New documents. We haven't added 26D to the tracker yet; plain-English summaries follow. Until then, here is what Oracle has already published.

When it arrives

Oracle updates environments in cohorts. Per Oracle, Cohort A gets quarterly updates in February, May, August and November, Cohort B in March, June, September and December, and Cohort C in April, July, October and January. Test environments update on the first Friday of the update month and production two weeks later, on the third Friday. Your cohort is shown in the Oracle Cloud Console. Source: Oracle Fusion Insider, "Quarterly updates made easy"

  • Redwood Enabled by Default for Person Pages in Update 26D (Human Resources, from the 26C What's New)

Opt-ins Oracle lists as ending with 26D (23)

From Oracle's Current Opt-In Expirations list. With 26D they become standard features. Oracle's "Now enabled" column shows Yes for 9 of them; the rest need setup if you want to use them. By area: 19 across Financials, Projects, Procurement and Supply Chain (no HCM opt-ins end in 26D), 2 in Permitting and Licensing, 2 in Sales. Oracle can update this list.
